standing: Writer-authored review discriminators, not executed trials, independent expectations or a shared actual-use oracle
source_binding: Owning anchors resolve in the six source members whose exact hashes are recorded in VALIDATION.json. Unchanged clauses retain preimage 199c6d29bc02590a8b7f252043fc43223c09808d bytes.

cases.case: Two records use the same spelling, but the reference resolves to the wrong record kind or to both a local and an external record.
cases.expected: Structural admission refuses the ambiguous or mistyped reference; payload equality cannot establish semantic identity or repair its basis.

cases.case: An interpreter has no operation grant and never evaluates a model constraint; no independent counterevidence or diagnosis decides that constraint.
cases.expected: The permission refusal and constraint truth remain separate predicates. The unperformed constraint remains indeterminate; the refusal cannot falsify its truth or establish no effects without evidence.

cases.case: A structurally valid task projection omits a material unresolved dependency to fit a smaller packet and then permits dependent work.
cases.expected: The fidelity claim fails for the declared use. Finite acquisition supplies no permission to remove the residual, and structural success does not establish semantic fidelity.
cases.argument_row: Task closure and projection; Interpretation and model validity

cases.case: A design has all named diagrams but permits two materially non-equivalent admission networks, and retained implementation selects one.
cases.expected: The boundary is not decision-complete; diagram presence does not permit implementation to own the unresolved design decision. Apply the existing sequencing/gate conditions.

cases.case: Method plus accepted design completely reconstruct an action's governing relations and show that the action violates one of them.
cases.expected: Reconstruction sufficiency can be satisfied while action lawfulness is falsified. Detecting the violation is not a reconstruction failure.

cases.case: A tenant realizes an operation through a human procedure with declared inputs, authority, effects, refusal, recovery and material effort measures.
cases.expected: Evaluate the actual execution binding. A human or mixed environment is permitted; software-module mechanics do not require disguising the process as software, and a role title alone would be insufficient.

cases.case: Function C needs a typed binding produced by A, but B's last output omits it; the implementation passes only B's output to C.
cases.expected: C's required composition input is missing. An earlier carried binding must remain available; merely declaring environment fields cannot prove its currentness, compatible basis or grant. The declaration recommendation retains should force.

cases.case: An admitted evaluate_action decision lawfully selects repair after an established edge-obligation violation; another attempt productively yields while evidence is pending.
cases.expected: The lawful repair decision can be satisfied while the edge remains falsified. Yield adds no failure classification; pending support and any existing failure remain visible. Neither decision establishes Product completion.

cases.case: Claim and event judgments are individually admitted, but the proposed cut has a mismatched source frontier or missing required relation edge.
cases.expected: The complete cut is not admitted, and no subset is promoted. Component success cannot replace material equality/membership joins; j_a remains the output of the assessment, never its own supporting input.

cases.case: A dispatched operation loses transport after a possible mutation, or a mutation is observed despite an absent grant.
cases.expected: Unknown completion cannot become no_effect, refused_effect or completed_effect without the required evidence. An unauthorized mutation remains an actual effect; inspect the owning subject before a dependent repeat.

cases.case: One event supports another and the latter corrects the first; the untyped union cycles, but each declared identity/causation DAG remains acyclic.
cases.expected: Do not infer a causal cycle from the untyped union. Relation kind and admitted causal evidence decide the causal claim; timestamps or common actors supply none.

cases.case: A unique, single-context entity has no lawful intervention or comparison population, but its eight surfaces are supported with explicit absence/non-applicability and residual ambiguity where appropriate.
cases.expected: Sparse entity publication remains possible under its own admission test and authority. No geometric overlay or comparison technique is mandatory individually, and a genuinely failed applicable obligation would still prevent satisfaction.

cases.case: A direction passes an admissible held-out treatment and its overlay publication checks, while direction-native conditional independence remains unmet.
cases.expected: Verification may satisfy the publication predicate, but the overlay remains candidate-class with respect to formal Markov closure. Ordinary entity-cut standing is separately decided.

cases.case: A representation space is refitted while ledger evidence stays unchanged, and a consumer proposes to reuse old identity directions as if their coordinates were unchanged.
cases.expected: The new space requires a superseding overlay. Directions from different spaces do not compose; the argument supplies no generic translation exception.

cases.case: Replay reproduces the expected State, ordered Cmds and an unknown-effect Msg after a lost response; the UI proposes to mark the underlying effect complete.
cases.expected: Replay fidelity can be satisfied while effect completion remains unknown. The effect membrane's recovery observes owning state before a dependent repeat; replay does not upgrade the effect claim.
cases.argument_row: Commands and observed effects; Replay proof

cases.case: A UX case has two plausible interpretations and an implementer prefers the weaker one without satisfying the stricter reading, constitutional repricing or a scoped design-module exemption.
cases.expected: The existing fail-closed ambiguity treatment remains operative. The source patch does not decide the reserved replacement or permit a ticket-only ambiguity exemption by analogy with the separate scaffold clause.

limits: These cases challenge selected distinctions and do not cover every signature field, design policy, ODD axiom, occurrence equality, world-model construction requirement or UX escrow condition.
Independent source-first review must fix its own expectations and assess applicability before any actual-use claim.
No shared protocol, runtime trial, statistical experiment, paid call or acceptance evaluation is performed by this return.
